on the latest news, views and issues affecting America, today.
The Prescott Art Museum hosts its monthly lecture series, “Inside Out” this Thursday, Sept. 27. The program will feature Soledad O’Brien, a longtime correspondent for CNN and “Inside Edition.” O’Brien will discuss “The Truth Will Set You Free: The Fight for the Soul of the Democratic Party.” A reception will follow the talk.
The talk begins at 10:30 a.m. in the Performing Arts Center, 1100 E. Sheldon St. For information, go to prescottartmuseum.org or call 928-777-1370.

October 24, 2013

The 5K Walk/Run and Survivor Dinner are scheduled from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. and are open to the public.

Unite for HER

October 24, 2013

MIDDLETOWN, NJ - The Middletown Township Police Department, along with representatives of Unite for HER, a national non-profit organization that fights sexual violence, will be at the Middletown Township Municipal Complex on Thursday, October 24, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. to provide information about sexual violence to the community and to raise awareness of Unite for HER’s upcoming 3rd Annual 5K Walk/Run and Survivor Dinner on Saturday, October 26, at the Middletown Sports Complex.

The 5K Walk/Run and Survivor Dinner are scheduled from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. and are open to the public.

“We are excited to be a part of this year’s Unite for HER,” said Police Chief Robert Regalbuto. �
